checks.test: const all = []; const walk = (rules) => { for (const r of rules) { all.push(r); if (r.cssRules) walk(r.cssRules); } }; for (const s of document.styleSheets) walk(s.cssRules); const rules = all.filter((r) => r.selectorText); const b = $('#tickets'); b.focus(); await tick(16); let ok; if (b.matches(':focus-visible')) { ok = style(b, 'outline-style') === 'solid' && parseFloat(style(b, 'outline-width')) >= 2 && style(b, 'outline-color') === 'rgb(109, 40, 217)'; } else { ok = rules.some((r) => r.selectorText.includes(':focus-visible') && !r.selectorText.includes(':has(') && r.style.outlineStyle === 'solid'); } b.blur(); return ok;
